name: test-network-3
label: Test Network 3 (large enterprise)
description: Large enterprise topology: 30 servers + attacker spanning DMZ (web/dns/mail/vpn), internal app/ftp/proxy tier, file/backup/monitoring tier, jump and bastion hosts, database cluster, admin servers, dual Active Directory, and a CI/CD pipeline (container registry, SCM, build server). 40 CVE instances — 10 nodes carry two CVEs and 20 nodes carry a single CVE.
